tasks.title: Contract 2.4.0 defines and validates runtime settings, channels and resend
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, all Files, Behavior, Checks and Completion evidence; R1; Decisions 9, 12, 14-16; Contract fields; Counterexamples; Security impact; Performance impact procedure 1; Acceptance evidence 1 and 7. Release all schemas, inferred types, never-throw same-object validators, exact constant/export inventory, sole scopes and audit enums together as 2.4.0 with committed dist and unchanged WIRE_VERSION. Include complete service-state/never-null invariants, reference-only definitions, database-only admin channels with file views only in service.report, failed view without the full report, report totals and all enumerated resend states. Enforce radius 32, component ids 64 ASCII characters, printable-ASCII https logo without userinfo, settings 65536 bytes and channel definition 16384 bytes; export/document aggregate 262144-byte measure for API enforcement. Smoke/type fixtures cover all four modules and literal exports/key lists, including status 8b6d431's 20 colors.

acceptance.command: bun test test/runtime-settings.test.ts test/notify-channels.test.ts test/resend.test.ts test/tokens.test.ts test/audit.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Validators never throw and preserve identity. Literal failures: duplicate order message 'componentOrder[1]: must not repeat an id', 61-character name, #12, 4pt, null, 33-character radius, 65-character/uppercase order id, logo space/non-ASCII/userinfo, PULSE_API_TOKEN ref, ../x, literal url, DB type file and Ops id. File view accepts file. Definition 16384 bytes accepted and 16385 refused ('channel: must be at most 16384 bytes as JSON'); four 200x200 routing lists refused. Reports reject 201 failed entries, 201 file channels and 101 shadowed ids; never/non-null report refused. Admin channels with file view refused; failed view carries no full report. queued/claimed result refused; admission/final outcomes accepted. status+read rejected with 'status must be the only scope'; status/notify location refused; notify metadata and older scopes accepted. notify-channel.create/check audit-kind mismatch refused. Largest valid settings below 40000 bytes; constants/export lists match the literals of Contract fields and status theme-config.ts at 8b6d431.

exit 0; lint, build, typecheck, type fixtures, full tests and the 80% coverage gate pass; smoke tests compare the exact Contract fields export inventory and all four new dist modules to a fresh build.

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after the rebuilt dist is committed; no dist difference remains.

PR includes check/dist output, new tests failing on ebf6bbc for missing exports then passing, applicable Security impact checklist and no new runtime package. Performance impact procedure 1 runs BEFORE contract merges without the API harness: independent main-merge-base worktree A and branch B, frozen installs, bash time user+system of bun run test/build, 5 rounds. Record full SHAs, all 10 raw values per metric, independently computed 3rd-smallest medians, FAIL regression when B-A exceeds max(A*0.10,floor), floors 2 s test/0.2 s build, FAIL budget above 9.0/6.4 s; committed dist is last B build and final dist diff is empty.
